writingQuestion: What is something you’d like to change, but can’t change on your own?

operatorNotes.arrival: Keep the waiting entrance visible while people arrive.
operatorNotes.polymind: Open writing in the Polymind session controls. Each participant records on their phone. You decide when to give the stop cue. Participants choose Stop recording, transcribe, review and correct the text, choose Replace my contribution with this transcript, then wait for Saved. Once everyone has saved, choose Close collection without analysis. Closing stops active recordings on the next refresh and excludes unsaved transcripts. Keep this round for All; do not start analysis yet.
operatorNotes.analogue: Find your partner and choose a shared pair suggestion. Keep the frozen Polymind round from 1 intact.
operatorNotes.four: Join two existing pairs and choose a shared fours suggestion. Keep the frozen Polymind round from 1 intact.
operatorNotes.polymind-all: Open the same Polymind session controls and projection used in 1. Choose Analyse frozen writing (or Close writing and analyse if collection is still open). This uses the reviewed, saved transcripts from 1 and publishes the completed overview. Do not open a new round.
operatorNotes.collective-voice: Open the separate Collective Voice session. Open microphone round, then Start / resume voice. End voice before moving on.
operatorNotes.puck: Collect the room’s answer options, prepare the Puck room, then show its invitation. Start the round separately in Puck room controls.
operatorNotes.flight: Load karlsruhe-747-landing and connect the bridge before the show; leave FlightGear paused. Recheck readiness before this cue. Participants join; release phone controls before unpausing locally. Connection loss does not pause FlightGear.
